brief: The canvas displays a deeply dark backdrop against which a constantly evolving field of bioluminescent abstract shapes appears. These fluid forms drift and ripple across the space, creating a hypnotic curtain of light. As the larger shapes dissipate, they break down into secondary, glowing particulates. These smaller lights flow downward, accumulating and pooling briefly near the bottom edge before slowly and smoothly dissolving back into the darkness. The overall effect is one of continuous, organic, and gentle movement, with the entire display changing naturally without any required interaction.
